name: sweep-pattern-signals
description: Cron daily 04:00 UTC + manual HTTP (internal-token gated). Surfaces patterns over the last 24h. Groups tickets by LLM-assigned topic_tag (recurring_topic kind) — skips singletons. Groups low-quality diagnoses by topic_tag (docs_gap kind). Only marks pattern_signals.surfaced=true AFTER substrate.propose('record_learning', ...) succeeds, so 5xx errors retry on the next cron tick instead of being permanently lost.
